en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Ja’far ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh Al-Mūsawi narrated to me from ‘Abdillāh ibn Nahīk, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from Ḥammād, from Al-Ḥalabi, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) said, “(Go) once a year because I do not want you to be identified.”
